title: Alternative + Shader Chaos Cubed Panorama 26.2
description: A better and ALTERNATIVE panorama for the "Chaos Cubed" drop in Minecraft 26.2. Even with a version that includes shaders!
body:
## About

That's it, a panorama showing a view of a rare sulfur cave generated on the surface, to replace the boring and dark default panorama of this game drop, 26.2. Well, I've seen many people complaining about this issue and wanted to give them a small original solution, instead of just recreating the original panorama with some torches.

**Screenshot - No shader version:**

![Screenshot No shader](https://i.postimg.cc/brG35HXw/2026-06-24-18-05-32.png)

**Screenshot - Shader version:**

![Screenshot No shader](https://i.postimg.cc/fy6BQtZp/2026-06-24-18-14-15-2.png)

Seed on which the panorama is based: 17825001432

---
